about.description: Single-stock perpetual on Aster (YZi Labs-backed) tracking Strategy Inc. Class A (MSTR), with pricing referencing Aster custom oracle (24/5 equity feed). Users gain linear exposure to Strategy Inc. Class A share-price moves without owning shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USD1 on BNB Chain / Aster Chain.
